title: ToolDefinition
description: Definition of one model-visible tool. The gateway validates args against input_schema, enforces permission_mode and requires in the before_tool hook, and forwards execution to the Python worker. Tool declarations are sent to the LLM sorted by name so the prompt prefix stays cacheable.

output_schema.description: JSON Schema for the result; must include status, artifact_id(s), provenance

execution_mode.description: sequential for tools that write to the same signal

estimated_cost.description: expression over args, e.g. n_windows * n_channels

requires.description: Deterministic preconditions checked by before_tool. Keys are dotted paths into the referenced artifact/manifest; blocked calls return the reason to the model.

provenance_steps.description: arg name -> steps that must appear in artifact.provenance.steps

manifest_fields_known.description: manifest fields whose Inferred.source must not be 'unknown', e.g. channel_layout, unit

model_compat.description: for run_model: minimum compat status of the chosen model_id on the input manifest

internal_functions.description: worker functions this coarse tool dispatches to (documentation only)

examples.name: extract_features
examples.description: 对窗口表计算特征，输出 features 产物和摘要。features：psd, bandpower, de, hjorth, band_stats, spectral_entropy, asymmetry, connectivity。de 需要 de_method 二选一（默认 libeer_filtfilt）。
